Message:
fix: give the smoke test a placeholder credential

The pnpm-install fix worked (deps resolve, ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND is gone),
but surfaced a second, pre-existing issue: CouncilService/P10Service
construct eagerly at process startup (index.ts top level, not lazily on
first tool call), so createAnthropicClient() throws immediately with no
credential configured at all — this is documented, intended behavior
(CLAUDE.md's MCP Server section already said "exits on startup if no
credentials are present"), not a new bug. An earlier claim this session
that credential checks are deferred until tool-call time was wrong.

The smoke test only needs to prove the launch command resolves and the
process runs — it never calls a tool, so a placeholder (non-empty,
never-real) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY satisfies the assertion without any actual
network access.

Verified end-to-end locally: fresh install, node_modules stripped,
placeholder credential — install completes in 1.5s, server starts and
stays alive.
